# MobilityEdge

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An energy threshold separating extended (delocalized) from localized eigenstates in a disordered or quasiperiodic system. Defines the boundary between propagating and trapped signals, critical for designing energy-selective routing and filtering in TCC architectures.
